_readme: S608 SkyCondor, 2026-11-08. College of the Redwoods: 38 of 73 passing. Its failures by shape (the Los Medanos method, lessons S600 and S605): 14 transfer degrees name the degree's 60 and CalGETC with no units (e.g. 35895 Biology AS-T, 31004 Psychology AA-T) and fail the degree check as incomplete; 8 local A.S./A.A. degrees name the 60 and no GE pattern or units (e.g. 44463 Personal Wellness A.S., 18231 Liberal Arts: Business) and read unequal. This read prints how a transfer page and a local page word their general education, and where the catalog states the units of Redwoods' local GE pattern and Cal-GETC, so a reconcile step can cite the catalog's own figure. Two program loads plus the links they follow, no model call.

questions.ge_units: The units the catalog states for Redwoods' local GE pattern and for Cal-GETC, how a local degree page and a transfer degree page name them, and whether the catalog prints a 60-unit minimum or an electives rule for local degrees.
